en.askTitle: Put in your own ages, pensions, savings and target areas to get the same visa, rent and monthly-budget check before you sign a lease
en.runTitle: A UK couple of 64 planning a D7 move to Portugal in autumn 2027: visa floor, rent, healthcare and tax against £3,200 a month

fields.label: Nationalities, UK residence and relationship
fields.value: a retired couple from the UK

fields.label: Pensions per person and scheme types
fields.value: combined pension income of £3,200 a month after tax

fields.label: Current tax deductions
fields.placeholder: e.g. £400 a month of income tax taken at source

fields.label: Healthcare needs and insurance quotes
fields.placeholder: e.g. one regular prescription each; two written insurance quotes

fields.label: Preferred areas and actual lease quotes
fields.value: near Lisbon: Cascais, Oeiras or Almada

en.template: Plan a Portugal retirement move for {couple}, {ages}, {arrival}, {pensions}, {tax}, {savings}, {health} and {areas}. Separate the D7 evidence floor from living costs, calculate scenarios from confirmed post-move net income, and flag what needs immigration, tax or insurance confirmation before a lease. Keep FX, dated adverts and unquoted allowances distinct. Plan only; do not apply, contact anyone, open accounts, book or pay.

phases.title: Three colleagues research in parallel: official D7 visa requirements, healthcare and tax on UK pensions, and live two-bedroom adverts
phases.note: Visa checklist and the income floor, public and private healthcare, the tax treaty, and dated rent examples
phases.judgment: It would not pass off the wrong insurance price as theirs: the only published premium it found (€49.20 a month) is for someone aged 57, and another insurer’s €25 a day is a hospital benefit, not a premium, so no price for two 64-year-olds is claimed.

phases.title: Write the friendly guide with rent examples, healthcare, tax and a monthly budget against £3,200
phases.note: Estimates and announced-but-not-yet-in-force changes are marked as such
phases.judgment: It told them plainly that the plan is tight: their income clears the D7 floor, but at £1 = €1.15 the illustrative €3,500 monthly plan leaves only €180, and the guide shows how that moves with exchange rates, rent and inflation.

phases.title: Independent review: recompute the budget, sample the raw rental evidence, then check links and page layout
phases.judgment: The reviewer found no numerical error and still raised two honest qualifications: the guide runs long, at about 3,800 words, and some early research steps used an existing browser profile rather than a fresh one, which the source record discloses.

workers: Read the official D7 visa requirements from the Portuguese consulate, the application centre and the immigration agency, with timings
Checked public healthcare access, private insurance examples and tax on UK pensions now the old resident regime has ended
Collected live two-bedroom rental adverts in Lisbon, Cascais, Oeiras and Almada
Independent review of the finished guide: recomputed the budget and sampled the rental evidence
